remarks: Second rules for the notes: a call of its own for what the reader knows so far, held to its length by code, and a last look at the threads left open. Two earlier runs under almost these rules were given up and left no record: one where a provider thought past the limit of tokens and its answer came cut, one where a provider hung for good. Between them they cost some $0.022 by OpenRouter's count, of which $0.005 no code kept track of. Since then a call has a time limit, an answer of no use is asked for again, and what it cost is counted.
